signals.label: Countries with significant internet outages (48 h)
signals.note: Aland Islands, Aruba, British Virgin Islands, China, Dominican Republic, Finland, Gibraltar, Israel, Lithuania, Nigeria, Norfolk Island, Northern Mariana Islands, Seychelles, Solomon Islands, Timor-Leste
signals.means: More countries with large internet outages may mean shutdowns, attacks on networks or grid failures.
signals.not_proves: It does not tell the cause: cable cuts, power cuts and censorship all look alike here.

signals.label: Kyiv City: networks answering internet probes, % of their 7-day norm (a dip = power cuts)
signals.note: today so far (2026-11-06); day before 97.63%. Generators and batteries hide part of a blackout; a dip can also be a network fault or a lasting change in what IODA probes (Kyiv City stepped down 4% on 23 Sep and stayed)
signals.series_kind: daily mean of responsive /24 blocks, % of the median of the 7 days before
signals.means: Fewer networks in a region answering internet probes than in the week before usually means power cuts: on 7-8 Oct 2026, when Kyiv had emergency cuts, Kyiv City fell to 94-97% while Lviv stayed within 3%.
signals.not_proves: It does not measure the blackout itself: generators and batteries hide part of it, and a network fault or a change in what is probed looks the same.

signals.label: Russia: presidential acts on call-up, mobilisation, reserves, military registration or exit (last 30 days)
signals.note: 2026-11-02 Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 02.11.2026 № 805 "Об установлении предельной штатной численности Минис; 2026-10-15 Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 15.10.2026 № 744 "О штатной численности органов прокуратуры Российской; 2026-10-12 Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 12.10.2026 № 730 "О временном порядке въезда в Российскую Федерацию и
signals.series_kind: matching acts per publication day (days with none omitted)
signals.means: More official acts on call-up, reserves, military registration or exit rules means the state is changing how it raises soldiers.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove mobilisation: since 2026 conscription runs all year under one December decree, staffing decrees (the authorised size of the armed forces) come every year or two, and many acts are technical.

signals.label: Estonia-Russia border: longest daily waiting time for cars heading into Russia (Koidula/Luhamaa, GoSwift)
signals.note: Estonia->Russia (GoSwift): Koidula 360 cars queued; Luhamaa first car slot in 26 d; Luhamaa 339 cars queued; max car wait 210 h on 2026-11-05
signals.means: A sudden jump means the Russian side is processing travellers slowly or more people are crossing: friction at Russia's western land border.
signals.not_proves: Direction is into Russia, not out of it; holidays, Russian checks and staffing move it. Not a count of people leaving Russia. The site does not state the unit; hours is inferred.

signals.label: Estonia-Russia border: 7-day mean of the daily maximum car waiting time (GoSwift)
signals.note: Estonia->Russia (GoSwift): Koidula 360 cars queued; Luhamaa first car slot in 26 d; Luhamaa 339 cars queued; max car wait 210 h on 2026-11-05
signals.means: A sustained rise in waiting time is a slower, steadier sign of tighter Russian border control or heavier traffic.
signals.not_proves: Seasonal travel and Russian processing capacity dominate; not specific to mobilisation.

signals.label: Estonia-Russia border: days until the first free car reservation slot (GoSwift)

signals.not_proves: Slot horizons depend on how much capacity the system opens for booking.
